title: gonolobus cteniophorus
intro: Gonolobus cteniophorus, commonly known as the "Cat's Claw Vine," is a tropical plant native to Central and South America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Gonolobus cteniophorus include antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides and other alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
